review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Nowadays, the news media are appearing more frequently in our daily lives. Despite the irrefutable benefits, this news entail largely inevitable drawbacks. Personally, I am of first school of thought.

I firmly believe that, the news media have a big influence on people's lives. This is because that with the presence of the widespread success to smartphones and the internet, these technologies allow people to follow the news instantly. Additionally, news become a regular part of people's routine. Moreover, the intense competition among new outlets appears popularly with the purpose of gain attention. Today, most idea agencies focus on shocking and breaking content. This means that those news are presented in a highly sensationalized manner with dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals. It naturally follows that this reinforces the overall impact of news on public opinion.

However, I strongly believe that the bad influence of news is true but it also brings undeniable benefits. With exposure to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news, people are easily overwhelmed. This, without any doubt - people feel overly anxious and helpless even in situations that do not directly affect them. By contrast, news coverage serves a virtual function as it constantly warns people to existing and looming problems in society - such as crime, natural disasters, or political corruption. To addition, individuals would have be better informed and more prepared to respond to potential threats, which plays a role in handling risks more carefully in an increasingly complex society.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that although the adding more news media offers certain advantages, it leads to drawbacks inevitably.

completion.comment: Cô đã đối chiếu đủ trang gốc: bài có mở bài, hai đoạn thân bài và kết bài.

review.overall: Em có đủ phần bài và phần lớn ý Cô giao, nhưng mở/kết chưa nêu đúng cùng một lập trường. Nhiều từ gần hình thức bị dùng sai nghĩa như success và virtual; lỗi news đi với động từ số nhiều lặp lại. Em cần viết lại, làm rõ tác nhân cạnh tranh và quan hệ kết quả, đồng thời giữ các chi tiết đúng đang có, kể cả handling risks more carefully.

I firmly believe that the news media have a big influence on people's lives. In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that the news media have a strong influence on people's lives: although this influence offers certain advantages, it can also lead to drawbacks.
